structured_summary: The robot announces the package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must give a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: Consequences if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (e.g., retry, abort, escalation)
